priority_items.title: Speaker confirms 22 Sep 11:30 CRC special sitting; Lal still unanswered
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC (17 Sep 12:00 FJT / 00:00 UTC): Speaker Filimone Jitoko confirms a Government-requested special sitting Tuesday 22 Sep 11:30 to table the CRC report; sitting is additional and does not affect the 28 Sep–2 Oct session; Business Committee confirmation. FijiVillage still homepage-leads Lal CDD 'autogolpe' overlay. Fiji Sun CDD updated 12:14 FJT. fiji.gov.fj still silent on CRC/HIV. Report unpublished. Referendum Bill unpassed. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Sogavare democracy statement; Wale UNGA still future-tense on Thursday
priority_items.summary: Island Sun (17 Sep) wires Opposition Leader Manasseh Sogavare's International Day of Democracy (15 Sep) statement: democracy must mean more than elections; Parliament without unnecessary interference; Opposition scrutiny is not an enemy of Government. Commemorative colour, not a no-confidence restart. Same outlet still says Wale 'will leave Solomon Islands today' for UNGA-81; local time 11:51 Thursday 17 Sep SBT — Wednesday travel day closed, Thursday morning still no wheels-up. SIBC 403; DFAT timeout. AUS–SLB still unsigned. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: UNAIDS welcomes HIV declaration; staff-shortage colour; still no gazette
priority_items.summary: Fiji Times (~2 h) reports UNAIDS welcoming Fiji's HIV-crisis declaration and supporting a needle-and-syringe programme. FBC leftover (09:50 FJT): Dr Jason Mitchell says the response is constrained by a health-worker shortage; Cabinet subcommittee hoped to mobilise staff. fiji.gov.fj still has no Legal Notice. Not FLASH.
